exact_tie.note: These dimensions have the same score; their letter order does not indicate a difference.
exact_tie.boundary: The tie describes this interest score only; it is not an ability, identity, or career conclusion.

near_tie.note: These scores are close, so the order should not be emphasized.
near_tie.boundary: This is a provisional reading threshold, not a statistical-significance or measurement-error conclusion, and it does not create a second measured result.
